notes: The default player is Direct: it streams through your own server with yt-dlp and saves nothing. The YouTube embed stays an option and is used when yt-dlp is missing.
If direct playback fails, it no longer switches to the embed silently. You get an error, a YouTube link and a button to use the embed.
New gear menu with:
Autoplay switch. With no queue or playlist it continues with "More like this".
SponsorBlock switch. A segment you deliberately seek into is not skipped.
Stable volume and Voice boost (browser audio engine, direct player only).
Audio track, for the language of dubbed videos.
Sleep timer, 5 to 60 minutes or at the end of the video.
Playback speed slider, 0.25x to 2x in 0.05 steps.
Subtitles, with language and style (size, colour, background, live sample).
Quality, up to 4K.

Quality: your preferred or Auto, and choose AV1 or H.264 (MP4). Auto picks AV1 only when it plays smoothly and otherwise uses the server's default stream. A failing quality retries the default stream first. Switching keeps your position. Portrait videos are named by their short side (1080p).
The CC button switches captions on and off.

Other player fixes: sound is restored on your first click or key after the browser mutes autoplay (if your audio keeps muting on new videos it's a browser permission); the theater button leaves fullscreen; the up-next banner draws inside fullscreen; keyboard focus moves into the gear menu and Escape returns to the gear button.

Subtitles: auto-generated captions are offered when a video has no uploader subtitles, in the app language and your browser's languages, and are marked "(auto-generated)". Fixed the CC button spinning forever and a failed lookup when yt-dlp reports no subtitles.
Fixed age-restricted videos (a bare "null" from yt-dlp) and an empty quality request in direct streaming.
Shorts use the youtube-nocookie.com embed.
Hide "Continue watching" (Settings > Experience > Navigation).
Hide the player's Download, Screenshot and Picture-in-picture buttons (Settings > Experience > Playback).
Auto-generated captions: show, only as a fallback, or hide (Settings > Experience > Subtitles).
The 42 known advisories reported by bun audit at fork time (12 in app, 30 in ui) are fixed; bun audit now reports 0.

Upgraded to the latest major versions: React 19.3.0, react-router 8.4.0, vite 8.3.2, TypeScript 7.0.2, @simplewebauthn 14, plus hono, fast-xml-parser, openid-client, sharp, hls.js, emoji-picker-react and lucide-react. Removed the unused vite-plugin-pwa.

New Linux release package (this file) with install-linux.sh, start.sh, update.sh and uninstall.sh. Bun, yt-dlp, Deno and ffmpeg are pinned by checksum and installed into the package's own ./bin folder; system copies are ignored. update.sh backs up your data first.
"bun run setup" (running from source) now downloads yt-dlp, Deno and ffmpeg into ./bin.

The in-app update check looks at this fork's releases, not Pelski's. Links to Pelski's releases, issues and wiki are removed from the app. This release's in-app changelog shows only the current version, with no notes.

Docker files and images, docker-compose, cloud deploy files (Render, Railway, Heroku, Fly, DigitalOcean, Zeabur, Kubernetes, Gitea), the Unraid template, the Proxmox script, community scripts and the old installer.
The tvOS app, the project website, the wiki folder, the promo-video script, and the docs about the browser extension, the TV app and local network discovery. The TV pairing page in the app is kept.
Issue and pull request templates, CODEOWNERS, CODE_OF_CONDUCT and the funding file.
README, SECURITY and CONTRIBUTING rewritten for a personal fork with no support promised. The README keeps only this fork's additions and links Pelski's project and wiki.
Logo and app icons now have a green background.
Linux x86_64: the automated install/update/uninstall on a Proxmox container.
